name: Should I build an attached in-law suite or convert existing space within my home?

mainEntity.name: Should I build an attached in-law suite or convert existing space within my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The decision between building an attached in-law suite or converting existing space depends on several factors, including available property, budget, and the desired level of independence for the occupant. Converting existing space, such as a basement or garage, can often be more cost-effective and have a shorter timeline if the space already has suitable structural elements and utilities. However, an attached addition provides more flexibility in design and layout. Consider the long-term use and potential resale value, as a well-integrated addition can enhance your home's functionality and value. AKN Design Group can help you evaluate your property and preferences to determine the most suitable approach.
